# Red-Shadow

Red-Shadow applies a black-and-red colour scheme aimed at a comfortable writing interface. Navigation is kept clear and the layouts respond to different screen sizes. Accent colours and other elements are changed by editing the theme's CSS rather than through a settings panel.

![Red-Shadow screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkliberty/Red-Shadow/HEAD/Resources/Screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Red-Shadow"
    author: "dkliberty"
    repo:   "dkliberty/Red-Shadow"
    slug:   "red-shadow"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/red-shadow"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/dkliberty/Red-Shadow"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkliberty/Red-Shadow/HEAD/Resources/Screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a minimalist black-and-red color scheme to Obsidian for a comfortable, modern writing interface. Keep focus with clear navigation and responsive layouts across screen sizes. Customize accent colors and other elements by editing the theme's CSS."
}
```
